name: Xiaomi CyberDog 2
description: Xiaomi's second-generation robot dog — a third the weight of the original CyberDog, packed with a 19-sensor perception suite and an NVIDIA Jetson-class compute module. Its ROS 2 SDK is published on GitHub under Apache 2.0, though some modules (like voice-assistant integration) remain closed-source binaries.

specs.label: Sensors
specs.note: 4 cameras, LiDAR, ToF, UWB, mic array

sourcing: Specs sourced from IEEE Spectrum's Robots Guide, TechNode's coverage of the August 2023 China launch, a TechInsights hardware teardown, TechCrunch's MWC 2024 report, and Xiaomi's own cyberdog_ros2 GitHub repo, as of September 2026. "Open Source" here refers specifically to the published ROS 2 SDK (Apache 2.0) — it is a partial release, not fully open hardware or firmware, and some software modules remain closed-source. Battery life (~1.5 hr) is single-sourced. No verified official international retail price exists; the ~$3,000 figure some outlets cite reflects reseller markup, not an Xiaomi list price. robotindex does not sell this product.

pricing.summary: Launched in China at **¥12,999 (~$1,780–1,800)** in August 2023. Xiaomi has not opened an official international sales channel — a **~$3,000** price reported at MWC 2024 reflects import/reseller markup rather than an official global retail price. robotindex could not verify a live official price for buyers outside China.

editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware
editorial.body: CyberDog 2 packs 19 sensors in an 8.9 kg body: four RGB cameras, an Intel RealSense stereo depth camera, time-of-flight sensors, a YDLIDAR TG30 unit, ultrasonic and UWB sensors, and a quad-mic array — per a TechInsights teardown, not Xiaomi's marketing. Compute is an NVIDIA Jetson-class module (Carmel CPU, Volta GPU, 8GB RAM), not Qualcomm as sometimes assumed.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: CyberDog 2's "open source" branding refers specifically to Xiaomi's published ROS 2 SDK (Apache 2.0) — a partial release, not open hardware or firmware, with modules like Xiaoai voice-assistant integration shipping closed-source and disabled by default. No verified official international retail price exists either.
